# Tees & Hoodies Hub

> Premium heavyweight apparel from Accra, Ghana. Shop 450-500 GSM tees, hoodies, sleeveless tops, polos, and custom printed apparel.

Tees & Hoodies Hub is an Accra, Ghana apparel and custom apparel brand focused on heavyweight essentials, clean silhouettes, and custom print production for brands, events, teams, and merch drops.

## Core pages

- [Premium apparel from Accra, Ghana](https://teesandhoodies.com/): Brand homepage for heavyweight tees, hoodies, and custom apparel made from Accra.
- [Shop collection](https://teesandhoodies.com/shop): Browse ready-made heavyweight tees, hoodies, sleeveless tops, and other apparel pieces.
- [Custom printing service](https://teesandhoodies.com/custom-prints): Order custom printed apparel for brands, teams, events, and merch drops.
- [Custom print studio](https://teesandhoodies.com/custom-studio): Create apparel mockups, choose placement, upload artwork, and submit a custom order.
- [About Tees & Hoodies Hub](https://teesandhoodies.com/about): Brand story, Accra roots, heavyweight fabric focus, and design point of view.
- [Contact](https://teesandhoodies.com/contact): Customer contact details for email, Instagram, order support, and custom apparel questions.
- [Blog](https://teesandhoodies.com/blog): Apparel guides, custom merch advice, product stories, and apparel care notes from Accra.
- [Frequently asked questions](https://teesandhoodies.com/faq): Answers on tracking, exchanges, sizing, washing, and order changes.
- [Shipping and delivery](https://teesandhoodies.com/shipping): Processing time, delivery windows, shipping costs, tracking, customs, and duties.
- [Return policy](https://teesandhoodies.com/returns): Return and exchange eligibility, refund steps, damaged item support, and return shipping.
- [Size guide](https://teesandhoodies.com/size-guide): Oversized fit notes, measurement guidance, and sizing support.
